mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal an economic slowdown that elevates equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both rise in the prior month, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets boost corporate profit margins and reduce equity risk, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals weakening consumer demand that reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1500 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic contraction that increases equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both decline in the prior month, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% annually), declining industrial production signals reduced corporate output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% annually, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
